tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search remixable low-poly 3D assets: creatures and mechs that walk with procedural IK, vehicles, buildings, nature and props. Returns coverage none|poor|ok; on none/poor say so honestly. Each result has tier free|pro (pro GLB downloads need a plan).

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Full metadata for one asset: real size in metres, palette, knob schema, rigged parts, gait for walkers, file URLs and ready-to-paste three.js code.

tools.name: get_variant
tools.description: Turn plain words into a createAsset({...}) call: colours ("red", "dark green"), sizes ("big claws", "tall", "8 eyes"), features ("no horn", "with porch"), option and preset names. English or Turkish. Check confidence; on none it returns the vocabulary.

tools.name: who_am_i
tools.description: Which Gaitkit account is calling (from the API key in the Authorization header), its plan, and the CDN token to put in shipped code. Anonymous callers get the free catalogue.

tools.name: report_need
tools.description: Register an asset the catalogue does not have yet. Use when search coverage is none or poor.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "who_am_i" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
